stock-proxy-master-selected-viral.head: 3e73b469c52e2f8b25522de949f7f15aade7f8b8
stock-proxy-master-selected-viral.scope: Stock casts for the three Coder hostile slots with empty and friendly refusals. 597 and 595 honor the respective 5 m and 7 m edges and paired state removals. 598 hits the selected hostile alone at 87 neutral and 71 with +75 viral resistance, paying 26 IS in this loadout. Stun Pulse wall-clock cast timing awaits reconciliation.

595.note: PR885 witnesses the selected hostile edge and 6 s Stun with 12 s immunity. The stock elapsed-time report was 4 s from request to landing while the retained GOB and runtime plan use 6 s for the cast. Behavior remains partial for this timing check. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

controls.source: GOB 595 specifies six-second Stun and separate 12-second AddControlImmunityTimer.
controls.runtime: The common hostile landing honors deflection and publishes the two independent TimedEffects lifetimes.
controls.test: PR885 observes both state records and paired removals with no HP change. StunPulseReachesTheSelectedAreaWithIndependentDeflectionAndImmunity verifies the independent deflection, immunity and expiry paths. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

area.source: GOB 595 uses a selected hostile direct object with seven-metre radius.
area.runtime: AbilityTargets centres the eligible hostile area on the actual selected entity and rolls each valid recipient separately.
area.test: Stock PR885 receives the pair on the primary and 7.00 m edge only. The 7.01 m hostile and allied control receive nothing. The live selected-area test exercises independent deflection and boundary inclusion. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

targeting.source: GOB 595 requires Coder Style, a selected enemy and TestFunction 2.
targeting.runtime: The loaded selected Coder cast checks Coder Style, range, sight and current hostile spawn, retaining identity through completion.
targeting.test: PR885 stock checks empty/friendly refusal and the positive spot. SelectedFieldUsesTheAdmittedLiveSpawnAndCannotSplashAfterInvalidation verifies range, sight, outside-combat, replacement and sight-loss cases. The independent deflection tests cover the selected target and splash. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

597.note: PR885 confirms a four-second cast, 43 IS at the loaded discount, 30-second reuse, two ten-second Enrage records and removals on eligible selected-area recipients. The shared player Enrage controls remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

area.source: GOB 597 uses a selected hostile with five-metre radius and ten-second Enraged.
area.runtime: The Coder selected-area path applies the non-damaging state to each independently eligible hostile.
area.test: PR885 observes the primary and exact 5.00 m edge only, with paired removal. The disposable coder-upper-viral-server scenario also puts the excluded hostile at 5.01 m. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

targeting.source: GOB 597 requires an outside-combat selected enemy in Coder Style, within 16 m.
targeting.runtime: The current view and spawn, style, visibility and hostile range bind before cost and are rechecked on the selected cast path.
targeting.test: PR885 verifies empty and allied refusal and an accepted actual enemy. The coder-upper-viral-server scenario checks invalid, style and stale-spawn controls, actual recipients and expiry. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

damage.source: GOB 598 defines fixed viral base 64 and an instant health effect.
damage.runtime: The fixed base reaches the shared viral hit, typed influence and resistance path.
damage.test: StaticBarrageUsesItsFixedViralBaseWithMatchingResistance and PR885 agree on 87 neutral and 71 under +75 Viral Resistance. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

targeting.source: GOB 598 is a Coder selected hostile cast with TestFunction 2 and 16 m range.
targeting.runtime: The cast checks the original hostile, membership, Coder Style, sight and range. The viral test applies to that single recipient.
targeting.test: PR885 verifies empty and allied refusal with no debit, then two accepted selected recipient hits with no splash. The disposable upper-viral scenario covers wrong style and stale-spawn rejection. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

source-parity.source: GOB 598 specifies the fixed 64 viral modifier. The legacy buff flag had prevented the required hostile landing.
source-parity.runtime: The ordinary selected cast bypasses that legacy buff classification for 598 and uses the shipped base with the existing typed result.
source-parity.test: PR885 sees the selected hostile take 87 then 71 on the resisted control. StaticBarrageUsesItsFixedViralBaseWithMatchingResistance independently pins raw 64, combined loaded influence +36 and both applied values. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662

behavior-tests.source: The authored single-target cast costs 27 IS before the loaded reduction, takes two seconds, and starts six-second own and four-second family reuse.
behavior-tests.runtime: The ordinary cost, cast, timer, hostile selection and typed health handlers execute the stored cast. Loaded 599 reduces the 27 IS cost to 26 in the verified profile.
behavior-tests.test: Stock PR885 observes both exact 26-point debits, cast/timers, exact neutral/resisted results, no splash and no max-vital or interlock side effect. The upper-viral replay and fixed damage test exercise the same production consumers. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/885#issuecomment-7088896662
